response.justification: Bogdan has extensive (19+ years) full-stack and infrastructure engineering experience and recent exposure to AI-agent tooling (MCP), but his career trajectory and titles (Senior/Staff Engineer) do not match the Director-level Principal Engineer scope of this role, and he lacks the deep AI/ML specialization, cloud strategy depth, and strategic customer advisory experience the position requires.
strengths: Long, diverse engineering career spanning web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure systems
Recent hands-on work with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code generators/frameworks
Entrepreneurial background as founder of an open-source geo-data platform (GISCollective)
concerns: No advanced degree or demonstrated deep specialization in AI/ML; only recent, limited AI-agent tooling exposure
Career level (Senior/Staff Engineer) is below the Director-level Principal Engineer scope expected for this role
No evidence of cloud strategy work, strategic customer/partner advising, or thought leadership specifically in AI/cloud

key_factors.factor: Seniority/title mismatch with Director-level IC role
Lack of AI/ML specialization or advanced AI degree
